server.title: Agent Traffic Lab
server.description: Execute supported agent tasks through verified providers with fallback and durable outcomes.

serverInfo.name: atl-mcp-entrance
serverInfo.description: ATL provides external task execution through eligible, verified providers for authorized search, public content extraction, summarization, translation, and classification. Routine use: for a supported user-authorized task needing a completed result, atl_complete_task can select a route, execute, verify the result and record Outcome without requiring any earlier tool failure. Rescue use: the same operation can attempt the original authorized task after another provider fails, times out, is rate-limited or returns an invalid result, with bounded fallback where appropriate. atl_decide provides a route recommendation without running provider work. A task must be user-authorized and within scope. Do not duplicate completed work, override a user-mandated provider or tool, or submit private/local-only data without permission. Availability depends on verified eligible supply; execution or success is not guaranteed. The initial public path does not require an ATL account or API key.
